name: Sunken Crypt
blurb: Flooded halls under the keep. Slow, shallow, forgiving.

name: Ember Mines
blurb: Coal seams still burning. Everything down here hits harder.

name: Frost Reach
blurb: Open ice. Nothing slows down, and nothing stops coming.

name: Rot Garden
blurb: Overgrown and thick with bodies. Dense from the first minute.

name: Black Spire
blurb: The top of the run. Bring a build you have actually levelled.
